random_split_time_block_decomposition.protocol: 50 post-hoc stratified random 60/20/20 splits, original selection routine
random_split_time_block_decomposition.caution: Each model sees examples from every time period in its training split. Block AUCs are based only on random-held-out test rows and are often unstable due to few failures.

missingness_time_diagnostic.split: separate random stratified 70/30 for unsupervised period diagnostic only
missingness_time_diagnostic.caution: Period separability from missing indicators is evidence of temporal input-distribution differences, not proof that SECOM failure predictions exploit them.

chronological_feature_filter_sensitivity.filters: training-period missing fraction < 40% followed by > 1e-12 training-period median-imputed variance
chronological_feature_filter_sensitivity.caution: Exploratory post-hoc feature filtering on an already seen time-ordered holdout.

limits: Exploratory tests were formulated after initial SECOM chronology and split results were known.
Block-wise random split scores still involve a model trained across all periods, including periods after each test observation.
Observed time variation of missingness and failure rates does not identify the causal mechanism of ROC-AUC change.
Oracle test-selected threshold is a hindsight diagnostic only, not a valid policy.
Only 17 failures are present in the final chronological test window.
